headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 5-4 victory over the Houston Astros, with Ernie Clement leading the Blue Jays' offense. In other action, the Los Angeles Dodgers fell to the Chicago Cubs 6-7, while the San Francisco Giants were shut out by the Texas Rangers 6-0. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Colorado Rockies 4-0, with Nick Martinez earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Arizona Diamondbacks right-handed pitcher Ryan Thompson, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a strained lower back. Other injured players include Hunter Greene of the Cincinnati Reds, Sam Bachman of the Los Angeles Angels, and James Wood of the Washington Nationals.

The Kansas City Royals made a significant move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Astros in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Houston Astros, with a final score of 5-4. Ernie Clement led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers suffered a 6-7 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the Cubs' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Shota Imanaga earned the win for the Cubs, pitching 5.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall to Rangers in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers defeated the San Francisco Giants 6-0, handing them their latest loss. Brandon Nimmo led the Giants' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Shut Out Rockies in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-0 victory over the Colorado Rockies, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Junior Caminero led the Rays' offense with a home run and RBI, while Tyler Wells impressed on the mound with 4 strikeouts in 1.1 innings.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks RHP Ryan Thompson Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-handed pitcher Ryan Thompson has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a strained lower back.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster following the trade.
